name: Sea Coast Rocks (Shallows Pillars)
title: Sea Coast Rocks
summary: Sea Coast Rocks are rock formations along the coast east of Arwic; this site films the southernmost, the Shallows Pillars (acpedia: '4 large stone pillars and some submerged rocks', 40.1N 68.2E). The kit has exactly four pillars standing in the surf at the foot of a sea cliff that rises 150 m+ to the west: two intact (19.8 m and 18.9 m) and two broken stumps (10-11 m), with the Shards of the Abyssal Totem scattered in the shallows. Open sea to the east.

landmarks.name: Sea cliff
landmarks.note: Terrain rises from 0 to 188+ within 60 m west of the pillars.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch1).

shots.standingOrder: Slide 16 m to the right 3 m above the tide line 30 m south-south-east of the tall stone pillar, counter-panning to hold it; nothing within 15 m, never over the cliff.
shots.notes: Shallows Pillars on the coast east of Arwic: four great stone pillars (19.8 m, 18.9 m and two broken stumps) stand in the surf below a 150 m+ sea cliff. A low parallax slide from the beach makes the near pillar sweep across the far pair and the cliff wall, sun from the left. shots.notes: Dolly-zoom on the outer 18.9 m pillar in the surf: the drone backs out over open water while the lens zooms, so the pillar keeps its size and the cliff behind it swells up the frame. Looking west-south-west toward the afternoon sun, so the pillar reads as a backlit silhouette against the cliff.
